#Load qPCR Results Data
```{r}
input_meta_path_20M_1a_qpcr <- here("data","qPCR_results","data","qPCR_raw","2022-04-21 120949_20M_1a_qpcr_named_results.csv")

remove_passive <- readRDS(file=here("remove_passive.RDS"))
qPCR_beluga_20M_1a <- read.table(input_meta_path_20M_1a_qpcr, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = F)[-1:-46, ] %>% 
    row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Marker = "Beluga",
         Plate="20m_1a") %>% dplyr::select(order(colnames(.))) %>% 
    #filter(., !Well %in% c(50, 123,97,99) ) %>% 
    filter(., !Well %in% remove_passive$Well )

qPCR_saleu_8makeup<- read.table(input_meta_path_saleu_8makeup_qpcr, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = F)[-1:-46, ] %>% 
    row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>% 
  mutate(Marker = "saleu",

  mutate(., Omit="",
         Quencher=""   ,
         `Ct Mean`=""  ,
          `Ct SD`=""  ,
         `Quantity Mean`="",
         `Quantity SD`="" ,
          `Automatic Ct Threshold`="",
         `Automatic Baseline`="",
         `Comments`="",
          `AMPNC`="",
         `HIGHSD`="",
         `NOAMP`="",
         `EXPFAIL`= "" ,
         THOLDFAIL="",
         PRFDROP=""  ) %>% dplyr::select(order(colnames(.)))

rbind(qPCR_beluga_20M_1a,qPCR_beluga_20m_1b_ex_k1_3,qPCR_beluga_kenai_2a,qPCR_beluga_kenai_1a,qPCR_beluga_8makeup) -> beluga_qPCR_data_combo

rbind(qPCR_saleu_20M_1a,qPCR_saleu_20M_1b_ex_k1_k3,qPCR_saleu_Kenai_1a,qPCR_saleu_Kenai_2a,qPCR_saleu_8makeup) -> saleu_qPCR_data_combo

setdiff(colnames(saleu_qPCR_data_combo)
,colnames(beluga_qPCR_data_combo)) -> cols_to_drop

setdiff(colnames(beluga_qPCR_data_combo)
,colnames(saleu_qPCR_data_combo))

saleu_qPCR_data_combo %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(cols_to_drop)) ->saleu_qPCR_data_combo_trimmed


rbind(saleu_qPCR_data_combo_trimmed,beluga_qPCR_data_combo) -> qPCR_data_combo
```

```{r}

qPCR_beluga_20M_1a %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity= str_remove_all(Quantity,",")) %>% 
  filter(., `Target Name`=="cetacea") %>% 
    filter(., `Task`=="STANDARD") -> standards

standards %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity=as.numeric(Quantity)) %>% 
  mutate(., CT=as.numeric(CT)) %>% 
  #filter(., !Well %in% c(50, 123,97,99) ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=CT, y=log10(Quantity), color=Well)) +geom_point()

qPCR_beluga_20M_1a %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity= str_remove_all(Quantity,",")) %>% 
  filter(., `Target Name`=="Moa IPC") %>% 
    filter(., `Well`%in%standards$Well) %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity=as.numeric(Quantity)) %>% 
  mutate(., CT=as.numeric(CT)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=CT,y=Well)) +geom_point()
```

```{r}
qPCR_data_combo %>% 
  filter(., Marker=="Beluga") %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity2 =str_remove(Quantity,","),
         Quantity2=as.numeric(Quantity2)) %>% 
    filter(., Quantity2>99999) %>%
  filter(., `Target Name`== "cetacea") %>% 
  mutate(., CT=as.numeric(CT)) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., min(CT), max(CT), mean(CT))
```

```{r}
qPCR_data_combo %>% 
  filter(., Marker=="saleu") %>% 
    mutate(., Quantity2 =str_remove(Quantity,","),
         Quantity2=as.numeric(Quantity2)) %>% 
  filter(., Quantity2>9999) %>%
    mutate(., CT=as.numeric(CT)) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., min(CT), max(CT), mean(CT))

qPCR_data_combo  %>% 
  filter(., `Target Name`=="Eulachon") %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity2 =str_remove(Quantity,","),
         Quantity2=as.numeric(Quantity2)) %>% 
  filter(., Quantity2>999)  %>%
    mutate(., CT=as.numeric(CT)) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., min(CT), max(CT), mean(CT))
  


```

```{r}
qPCR_data_combo %>% 
  left_join(qPCR_names_combo) -> qPCR_combo



qPCR_combo %>% 
  mutate(., Plate.Name = case_when(str_detect(Sample.Name, "Kenai_1a") ~"Kenai_Plate_1a",
                                 str_detect(Sample.Name, "Kenai1a") ~"Kenai_Plate_1a",  
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "Kenai1b_") ~ "Kenai_Plate_1b" ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "Kenai2") ~"Kenai_Plate_2"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "Kenai3a_") ~"Kenai_Plate_3"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "20M_plate_1a") ~"TwentyMile_1A"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "8makeup") ~"8makeup" ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "20m1b_") ~"TwentyMile_1B" ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "extra_tube_1") ~"Extra_tube_1"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "extra_tube_2") ~"Extra_tube_2"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "extra_tube_3") ~"Extra_tube_3"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name, "extra_tube_4") ~"Extra_tube_4"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "extra_tube_5") ~"Extra_tube_5"  ,
                             str_detect(Sample.Name , "extra_tube_6") ~"Extra_tube_6"   ,
                            str_detect(Sample.Name , "extra_tube_7") ~"Extra_tube_7" ,
                            TRUE ~"Other"),
         Plate.Number=Plate_Name) -> qPCR_combo

qPCR_combo$Plate.Number <- as.character(qPCR_combo$Plate.Number)

qPCR_meta_combo %>% 
  mutate(., Plate.Number=case_when(Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_1"~"1",
                                   Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_2"~"2",
                                   Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_3"~"3",
                                   Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_4"~"4",
                                   Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_5"~"5",
                                   Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_6"~"6",
                                   Plate.Name=="Extra_tube_7"~"7",
                                   TRUE ~ Plate.Number))->qPCR_meta_combo



qPCR_combo %>% 
left_join(qPCR_meta_combo, by = c("Plate.Name", "Plate.Number")) -> qPCR_AK_data


qPCR_AK_data %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity=str_replace_all(Quantity,",","")) -> qPCR_AK_data

# Quantity is 2uL of input DNA in 10 µL

qPCR_AK_data %>% 
  filter(., is.na(New_name_no_tech) | str_detect(New_name_no_tech,"Diet", negate = TRUE)) -> qPCR_AK_data

saveRDS(qPCR_AK_data, file=here("data","qPCR_results","data","qPCR_results","qPCR_AK_data.RDS"))

```

```{r}
qPCR_AK_data %>% 
   filter(., Quantity > 0) %>% 
  filter(., Sample_Control =="Control") %>% 
     filter(., Project =="Passive") %>% 
  mutate(., Quantity = as.numeric(Quantity)) %>% 
  filter(., `Target Name` %in% c("cetacea","Chinook","Coho","Eulachon")) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x=LabID, y= Quantity, colour=`Target Name`)) +geom_point()+ facet_grid(. ~ `Target Name`, scales="free") +theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size=8), axis.title = element_text(size=18), strip.text = element_text(size=16)) + ggtitle("Passive Filter")


 ggsave(file = here::here("analysis", "figures", "passive_filters.png"),
  width = 30,
  height = 8
  )
```

```{r}


qPCR_AK_data %>% 
  filter(., `Sample Name`!="" & Sample.Name !="") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Marker =="Beluga") %>% 
  filter(., `Target Name` =="cetacea") %>% 
  filter(., Task =="UNKNOWN") %>% 
  mutate(Quantity = ifelse(is.na(Quantity), 0, Quantity)) %>% 
  filter(., !is.na(LabID)) %>% 
  filter(., Quantity > 0) %>% 
  mutate( Site = case_when(Project =="Beluga_Diet"~"Beluga_Diet",
                                Control_Type=="Neg"~"Neg",
                                 Control_Type=="Pos"~"Pos")) %>% 
  filter(., !is.na(River)) %>% 
  mutate(., Sample_date=as.Date(Sample_date,"%m/%d/%y")) %>% 
 ggplot(aes(x=Sample_date, y=Quantity)) + geom_point()+ facet_wrap(River ~ ., scale="free_x")+ theme_bw() +theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size=14), axis.title = element_text(size=18), strip.text = element_text(size=16)) + scale_y_sqrt(breaks=c(0,10,50,100,200,400)) +ggtitle("Beluga qPCR Detections")



 ggsave(file = here::here("analysis", "figures", "beluga_qPCR_detections.png"),
  width = 30,
  height = 8
  )
```
